findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:654,881 — The change proves that 804 is reproducible and that only the ceiling code changes, but it does not prove the asserted cause that the four builds above 800 are legitimate current-source-inventory growth rather than an existing binding/cache/duplicate-analysis regression. The RED record reports synthetic=419/repo=385 and the green receipts repeat 804; neither supplies a prior-good per-file build-map comparison, expected newly included files, or an invariant showing no per-file duplicate-build increase. Raising the absolute limit to 820 therefore accepts the unexplained behavior and can mask the exact algorithmic regression this budget is intended to detect. Before loosening the limit, add causal evidence over dynamicBindingBuildFiles (or equivalent known-good/current comparison) that accounts for the +4 as intentional inventory; if it exposes duplication, repair the algorithm instead.
findings.resolvedReason: Replaced the unexplained 820 ceiling with 808 after a causal known-good/current comparison. Detached build at 0abf3d859d measured 796 total = synthetic 419 + repo 377; current measured 804 = synthetic 419 + repo 385. Instrumented per-file maps showed exactly eight +1 repository entries and no removed or increased existing entry: core/brand-paths.ts, core/certification-window.ts, core/review-inventory-epoch.ts, handlers/certification-window.ts, tasks/adapter-session-env.ts, tasks/brand-path-resolver-smoke.ts, tasks/certification-window-smoke.ts, tasks/signing-guard-mutation-proof-smoke.ts. Commit 598dfeb805 therefore sets 808, preserving the prior fixed four-build headroom rather than widening it.

findings.desc: B-5952 CHK-001 edge/adversarial verification receipts do not execute the promised finite-bound mutations. The edge command merely checks JavaScript tautologies `c<=c` and `!((c+1)<=c)` after reading the constant; the adversarial command only greps the comparator and evaluates constant-false `804<=803`, so neither rebuilds/runs a ceiling+1, below-804, unbounded, relative-only, or warning-only mutant. The source/dist+doc receipt is also stored non-mechanical without an execution receipt. Independently, `pre_review_check_read {storyId:B-5952}` currently reports FAIL with PR_MUTATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING, PR_MUTATION_DID_NOT_BITE, PR_CONTROL_NOT_RESTORED, PR_TRANSCRIPT_MISSING, and PR_AUTHORITY_INADMISSIBLE. Replace the tautological probes with isolated executable mutations that first fail, restore the committed control, then pass, and record verifier-admissible receipts.

packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:884 — CHK-001:edge:0 and CHK-001:adversarial:0 do not execute the guard boundary or a real mutation. The edge receipt only evaluates the tautologies c<=c and !((c+1)<=c); the 803 receipt only evaluates the constant false expression 804<=803 and greps for comparator text. Both can PASS if the assertion is dead, warning-only, or fails to reject 821. CHK-001:adversarial:1 is also mechanical=false with no result/receipt, and its command checks only the current positive source/dist/doc state rather than proving source-only, dist-only, and document mutations fail. Add an isolated executable mutation harness that exercises the actual guard/smoke with 820 accepted, 821 and 803 rejected, weakening/removal rejected, source/dist drift rejected, and protected-document drift rejected. Severity high because preserving absolute boundedness and fail-closed rebuild/scope binding is the Story objective.
